faqs.question: Is head, neck and shoulder massage available at home in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. SMS Home Ladies Salon provides head, neck and shoulder massage at homes and selected locations across Dubai.

faqs.question: How is this different from head and shoulder massage?
faqs.answer: This option explicitly gives focused time to all three areas: the head, neck and shoulders, with an upper-back transition where appropriate.

faqs.question: Can I choose the pressure level?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your therapist confirms pressure preference and any sensitive or avoided areas before starting.

faqs.question: Which duration should I choose?
faqs.answer: Choose 60 minutes for a focused appointment or 90 minutes when you want more time across all three areas.

faqs.question: What should I prepare before the appointment?
faqs.answer: Prepare a comfortable space and share any mobility, sensitivity or positioning needs when confirming the booking.

faqs.question: Can I combine this with another service?
faqs.answer: Yes, depending on timing and therapist availability. Send the services you want and our team will confirm the best booking option.

faqs.question: Is dry cupping therapy available at home in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. SMS Home Ladies Salon offers dry cupping appointments at homes and selected locations across Dubai, subject to suitability and availability.

faqs.question: Does this cupping service pierce the skin?
faqs.answer: No. This page is for dry cupping, which uses suction on intact skin without skin piercing or blood removal.

faqs.question: Can cupping leave marks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Temporary circular marks can occur. Tell the professional about skin concerns before treatment and seek medical advice for unexpected or persistent reactions.

faqs.question: Who should seek medical clearance before booking?
faqs.answer: Anyone who is pregnant or has skin, bleeding, clotting, medication or other health concerns should consult a qualified healthcare professional first.

faqs.question: How is hygiene handled?
faqs.answer: The professional prepares a clean service area and uses hygiene-checked cupping equipment and fresh materials for the appointment.

faqs.question: Does cupping replace medical treatment?
faqs.answer: No. Cupping is a complementary wellness service and is not a substitute for medical diagnosis, advice or treatment.
